findings: Fifteen received frames include eleven with sole-indirect topology. The complete desktop and Run are visually verified. Run appears about 114 seconds after input. A OneDrive prompt also renders; Notepad only becomes visible on the ordinary restored display.

The worker returns 728 successful NPU results and matching acknowledgements. Two rejected Notepad draws exceed the triangle raster budget. No command-queue creation error or NPU device-loss error is logged. The final socket-closed message follows ordinary finite shutdown; worker exit is 1.

The complete 756-by-406 Notepad capture reproduces the raster-budget failure on CPU. Its solid-color 12-vertex strip expands to 30 vertices. The batch selector unnecessarily reduces 4096 to 8 to divide the surface area exactly. A partial-batch fix is being qualified separately.

The first negative response is also preserved byte-for-byte as slow-request-3.bin, SHA256 8994c10f18744f068cff2e35eb92006b17a341e5dd2fd58828c645a35e634b1f. It contains the actual driver request and supports a direct packet regression test.

Trace storage reaches its 512 MiB limit. The initial recorder subsequently saves some smaller requests, creating gaps: 219 contiguous initial requests plus 25 later requests. It does not preserve the full ordering before the Notepad failure. The next recorder must latch capture closed and continue logging metadata after reaching its bound.

Logical retained pipeline counts reach eight uniform, twenty-four triangle, four clear, one point and one linear pipeline. These are not hardware queue counts. Compilation count exceeds v114 without device loss; this does not prove stability or identify the previous runtime fault.

The observer completes its finite interval and removes both custom guest drivers. No NPU restart or physical reboot is needed. The owned VM is cleanly shut down afterward to renew its finite host lease.

The background capture watcher completes its guest capture but its final copy races a manual snapshot transfer and fails with a sharing violation. The independently hash-verified snapshot and final guest manifest preserve the same capture; this is a transfer failure, not a rendering result.

The guest login helper initially types while the lock screen lacks a focused password field. After focusing the empty field, login and the ordinary pretrial desktop are visually verified before installation.
Full desktop offload, usable interaction, physical scanout migration and Tahoma improvement remain unverified.
